summary: Lightwave Logic filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its existing sales agreement with Roth Capital Partners, increasing the maximum offering amount to $51,404,500. Prior to the amendment, the company had sold 8,079,319 shares for gross proceeds of approximately $35 million under the same at-the-market facility. The filing is a routine capital markets update, not a special situation event. There are no strategic M&A, activist, or restructuring elements. Watch for further shelf takedowns and potential dilution, but no actionable risk-arb angle exists.
